amass.abilityText: If you have no Action cards in play, gain an Action card costing up to $5.

asceticism.abilityText: Pay any amount of $ to trash that many cards from your hand.

continue.abilityText: Once per turn: Gain a non-Attack Action card costing up to $4. Return to your Action phase and play it. +1 Action and +1 Buy.

credit.abilityText: Gain an Action or Treasure costing up to $8. +D equal to its cost.

foresight.abilityText: Reveal cards from your deck until revealing an Action. Set it aside and discard the rest. Put it into your hand at end of turn.

gather.abilityText: Gain a card costing exactly $3, a card costing exactly $4, and a card costing exactly $5.

kintsugi.abilityText: Trash a card from your hand. If you've gained a Gold this game, gain a card costing up to $2 more than the trashed card.

practice.abilityText: You may play an Action card from your hand twice.

receive-tribute.abilityText: If you've gained at least 3 cards this turn, gain up to 3 differently named Action cards you don't have copies of in play.

sea-trade.abilityText: +1 Card per Action card you have in play. Trash up to that many cards from your hand.
